services.name: Choose your Cruise
services.desc: The Blue Moon, based in Marina Del Rey, is a quick drive for anyone living in or visiting the Los Angeles area. We offer Private Cruises for groups of up to 6 and up to 12 people. This includes a captain and crew ready to take you anywhere you want to explore in Santa Monica Bay. We have been taking dolphin cruises off the coast of Los Angeles, out of Marina Del Rey, for 20 years. The Blue Moon Private Boat tour offers you an outdoor adventure with friends, family or coworkers. You can bring music, food and beverages of your choice. blurb: Guests take private cruises on a 40-foot marine trawler to see dolphins and other marine life off the coast of Los Angeles. The boat offers seating and sunbathing areas on the upper deck, bow, and stern. Cruises are private and can accommodate up to 12 passengers.

quotes.text: I use the Blue Moon once a year, because my friends love seeing the ocean in its full glory. We could bring our drinks and food on board, and Captain Chris makes us feel welcome. Highly recommended!!
It was such a serene day out at sea and it couldn’t have been more relaxing than to just hang out up top with the sun setting down on us having fun with all of our friends.
This boat is great! At one point, we were in the middle of about 7 whales. We brought our own food and drinks on board and had a spectacular day.
